evidence.detail: R118 ScriptPacket 3 (rs/q/a/a/a/l) constructs exactly two instances of this class: '<img=9> Claim' with misc/treasure sprites and '<img=288> View' with misc/mail sprites, then adds/removes the selected instance through the live overlay manager.
The constructor fixes a 40x40 overlay, binds it to exact render stage AFTER_WIDGETS_BEFORE_INTERFACE_HIGH and exact TOP_RIGHT placement.

The class receives normal/hover sprite names and two colors through its constructor, animates opacity between 100 and 200, hit-tests the live mouse over its rectangle, swaps normal/hover sprites, displays the configured hover/action text and invokes an optional draw callback with x, y, opacity and hover state.
The class accepts an optional execute callback, and its activation hook schedules that callback; the two R118 instances bind the exact ::claimcoffer and ::mail actions through this callback path.

proposals.note: ConfigurableActionPromptOverlay is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the callback-composed 40x40 action prompt implementation used by ScriptPacket 3. The 'Configurable' qualifier deliberately distinguishes it from R113's separate abstract ActionPromptOverlay family. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: The interface has exactly one surviving abstract method named execute() with descriptor ()V.
Its only concrete consumer is ConfigurableActionPromptOverlay, which stores one instance and invokes execute() from the prompt activation path.
R118 ScriptPacket 3 supplies this interface with two lambdas whose bodies send the exact commands ::claimcoffer and ::mail for the two action prompts.

proposals.note: ActionPromptExecuteCallback follows the exact surviving execute() functional method and its exclusive use as the activation callback for ConfigurableActionPromptOverlay. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: The interface has exactly one surviving abstract method named draw(int,int,int,boolean) with descriptor (IIIZ)V.
Its only concrete consumer is ConfigurableActionPromptOverlay, which invokes draw(x, y, opacity, hovered) after rendering the prompt shell.

R118 ScriptPacket 3 supplies this interface for both prompt instances; each callback draws the same client sprite at the prompt-relative offset, confirming a render-extension callback rather than an action callback.

proposals.note: ActionPromptDrawCallback follows the exact surviving draw(...) functional method and its exclusive use as the render-extension callback for ConfigurableActionPromptOverlay. Confidence is 0.999.
